output.summary: Attempt 2 after re-review: every refreshing-claude test now has a test timeout (15 s, or 30 s where a 10 s helper-reaping poll runs), and 'a cancel after the claude itself exited' waits for its pid and the claude's exit with the test's signal. A spawn-failure mutant (no pid ever written) now ends the file in 150 s with 20/20 tests failing, instead of hanging; controller source restored byte-identical. Normal: 20/20 three times. Bounded tests took at most 3.7 s under 36 stress threads. Unchanged from attempt 1: claw 120 s start wait (STARTUP_MS exported), lean-lifecycle CLI limit STARTUP_MS.claw + 60 s, mocked controller clock for the stop tests, 7 controller mutations caught. Commits b8649d5, cfb14c4, 10a5642.

Independent report-only review, three passes: b8649d5 With fixes (mocked-clock tests could hang) -> cfb14c4; re-review With fixes (three non-mocked lock tests unbounded) -> 10a5642; final check Ready to merge Yes. Two non-blocking, pre-existing follow-ups recorded (empty-pid read in 'a cancel after the claude itself exited'; pid path under HOME).

Fresh verification after the review fixes, on final commit 10a5642 with no other test suite running: root npm test 1092/1092 exit 0 (80 s); claude-controller 20/20 three times; npm run typecheck exit 0; Story checker exit 0. Under induced load: lifecycle files 16 stress threads 5/5 (75/75) with the 120 s claw wait (RED 1/3); claude-controller 36 threads 6/6 (120/120) on 10a5642 (RED 1/4). Changed-file scope: src/cli/lifecycle.ts (claw-only STARTUP_MS 120 s, exported), tests/claude-controller.test.mjs, tests/fixtures/fake-claude.mjs, tests/lean-lifecycle.test.mjs; controller source and its 6 s/12 s values untouched. Unproven: claw start beyond the measured load; two real full suites at once (one-at-a-time rule); a 'still starting' message during the 120 s wait; pre-existing follow-ups from the review. G4 pending the user's answer.

Load-only failures. (1) 'Office startup timed out.' in the two claw-starting tests: claw's start is CPU-bound (tsx transpiles ~220 vendor TS modules; cold cache per data dir), measured 1-2 s idle, 7.5-51 s under CPU stress with heavy swap, 2/12 over 60 s; lean/legacy < 3 s. Fix: src/cli/lifecycle.ts exported per-engine STARTUP_MS, claw 120 s, others 15 s; lean-lifecycle CLI spawnSync limit STARTUP_MS.claw + 60 s. RED: lifecycle files at 16 stress threads 1/3 runs; 60 s attempt 3/4 valid; GREEN 120 s 5/5 (75/75). (2) claude-controller stop tests raced real timers ('timed out while it refreshes' ENOENT 3/4 at 36 threads). Fix: t.mock.timers for setTimeout (controller clock), progress via marker files on a captured real timer, 5999/6000 ms assertions, boundary fixture waits to be killed, helper polls 10 s; review fixes: 15 s test timeouts on frozen-clock tests, refreshingClaude(t) kills the process group (skips empty pid: kill(-0) hit own group), reached() stops on t.signal. GREEN 36 threads 6/6 (120/120); 7 controller mutations caught, no fake left; controller source unchanged (6 s/12 s untouched). Commits b8649d5, cfb14c4.

Two independent report-only reviews. Review of b8649d5: With fixes (mocked-clock tests could hang the file on a no-SIGTERM mutant; minors) - fixed in cfb14c4. Re-review of cfb14c4: With fixes - three non-mocked lock tests ('cancelled while it refreshes', 'a process the claude started', 'a line the claude prints') can poll forever without a test timeout when the fake never writes its pid.
